name: awaaz-saas
description: Awaaz — AI-powered multilingual multi-user SaaS platform (separate frontend and backend workspaces)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@awaaz/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@awaaz/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@awaaz/frontend
